turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Chrononutrition is an interesting field, and while there is some evidence suggesting that disrupting our natural sleep-wake cycles can negatively impact cognitive function, more research is needed to definitively confirm these benefits. Many studies show that aligning our sleep patterns with our natural circadian rhythms tends to enhance mental clarity and focus. However, individual differences play a big role, so what works for one person might not work for another. It’s always a good idea to listen to your body and experiment to find what works best for you.
